verdict: AVOID — six straight years of operating losses, and the latest year halved revenue while still losing ₹1,833cr
points: Not held, and the missing earnings multiple is the finding rather than a gap. Ola Electric Mobility, ₹17,162cr, electric scooters and lithium-ion cells. pe_ttm, peg and ev_ebitda_ttm are NULL and there is no own-history PE band — but not because coverage failed. The company has never reported a positive operating profit: the six annual rows run -₹277cr, -₹800cr, -₹1,252cr, -₹1,266cr, -₹1,735cr and -₹978cr. There is no numerator for a multiple to divide into, and there never has been. Composite 15 on quality 12, valuation 24, momentum 28.

Revenue is now going backwards too, which is what changes this from a loss-making growth story to an avoid. Sales went ₹2,631cr → ₹5,010cr → ₹4,514cr → ₹2,253cr: the last year is half the peak. TTM revenue -49.16%, quarterly sales -45.05%, three-year revenue CAGR -32.94%. The operating margin is -48.94% against -47.89% a year earlier and a three-year mean of -35.70%, with the three-year trend at -0.0907 — the loss per rupee of sales is widening as the sales shrink. Interest is ₹360cr a year against no operating profit. Three-year ROCE -25.18%, free-cash-flow yield -11.50%, debt/equity 0.825.

What would have to be true for this to work, and is not: scale. At 5.12x book, 12.77x EV/sales and asset turnover of 0.289, the price is paying for volume growth that has reversed. Promoters have taken their holding from 36.78% to 32.96% across the last four quarters while 1.94 million retail shareholders sit on the register. It has lagged the market 36.2% over twelve months and spent 15.1% of the year above its 200-day EMA, with the 9/20/50 stack not bullish. Confidence is low because cfo_pat_3y, np_cagr_3y and ttm_np_pct are NULL — the quality pillar carries 82 of 100 points — but the absence of those three does not point the other way.
trigger_text: Revenue growth turning positive with the operating margin closing toward breakeven from -48.94% -> re-read; a resolved EV/EBITDA would follow on its own, and the avoid comes off. Another year of contraction at a widening loss -> the ₹17,162cr of market value is being set by the cell-factory story rather than by the P&L, and the gap closes downward.

verdict: AVOID — ₹5.7cr of operating profit against ₹47.4cr of interest, on 3.4x gearing at 18.6x book
points: Not held, and not data-blocked — it is the best-covered name on this list. The one good-looking number is an artefact, and here is which one. Three-year ROCE reads 40.13% against five-year ROCE of -22.30%. The ROE threshold was cleared in 1 of the last 10 years, 1 of 7 and 1 of 5.

What the price is asking for. Debt/equity 3.444, 18.59x book, EV/EBITDA 92.61x, free-cash-flow yield -4.76% — a balance sheet that needs equity priced as though the turn has already happened. The recent operating lines are genuinely better: TTM operating profit +81.98% on revenue +21.29%, margin 5.00% against 3.34%. That is real, and it is still not enough to cover ₹47.4cr of interest. Promoter holding fell from 70.12% to 61.30% over the last two quarters. 14,689 shareholders, and no delivery row to read the flow. Confidence is low because ttm_np_pct is NULL and there is no company overview — the recovery could be larger than it looks. The leverage does not care.
trigger_text: Operating profit covering interest more than once over, with cash conversion turning positive from -15.46 -> the avoid comes off and this becomes a real recovery candidate at a sane multiple. Another year of operating profit below the interest bill on 3.4x gearing -> the equity is an option, not a holding, and 18.6x book is the wrong price for one.
